On-Chain Operator. Module 8 · The operating system. Navy and cyan. This is the door, not the whole module. Education only.
You can already pull a number off a chain. The operating system is what you do with it: a register, a journal, and a kill rule.
By the end of the module you will be able to do this: a written portfolio plan with risk buckets, limits and an emergency plan. Not before. The lessons earn it one page at a time.

The lessons, in order, are 8.0 Mastery Starter, 8.1 DeFi portfolio construction, 8.2 The DeFi risk framework, 8.3 Strategy library, 8.4 The operating playbook: deploy, monitor, respond, review, 8.5 Measuring performance honestly, 8.6 Psychology and discipline, 8.7 Quantitative risk: volatility, VaR, drawdown, correlation and sizing. You do not skip ahead. Each page is the input to the next.
Lesson 8.0, Mastery Starter. Mastery Starter. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.1, DeFi portfolio construction. Split capital into risk buckets with caps, so no single failure can sink the portfolio. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.2, The DeFi risk framework. Keep a risk register that scores every position's risks and names the response. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.3, Strategy library. Strategy library. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.4, The operating playbook: deploy, monitor, respond, review. Run every position through the same four-phase routine. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.5, Measuring performance honestly. Measure your results so deposits, withdrawals and lucky markets don't fool you. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.6, Psychology and discipline. Recognise the behaviours that turn good strategies into losses, and build rules that stop them. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 8.7, Quantitative risk: volatility, VaR, drawdown, correlation and sizing. Put numbers on portfolio risk and size positions from them. You will write that down when you get there.
